channel.title: Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily tech opinions digest for Yun Zhou

item.title: Cory Doctorow: The AI fatfinger economy has come for my receipts app
item.description: Every useful button now summons an AI genie: Doctorow argues the KPI-driven 'fatfinger economy' is how vendors fake AI adoption numbers without generating any real usage.

item.title: SemiAnalysis: Elon Is Doing It Again - SpaceX Will Be The World's Biggest AI Cloud
item.description: SpaceX already has 3.6GW of datacenter capacity under construction and a revised ~13GW target for 2027 - roughly all of Google's datacenter capacity from 1999-2026, built in 18 months.

item.title: Bruce Schneier: AIs Hacking the Law
item.description: LLMs are now finding previously unrecorded vulnerabilities in the German legal system at scale - the 'hacking the law' idea from his 2021 essay, arriving for real.

item.title: Too many real bugs: what the AI-assisted PR flood really costs
item.description: PostgreSQL 19 slipped because AI-assisted testing surfaced more real bugs than maintainers could triage, while Trail of Bits cleared 149 CVE fixes - two answers to the same flood of AI-found flaws.
